To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The elaboration of hormones, biologically-active and biologically-inactive factors by renal adenomas and adenocarcinomas is a unique and important manifestation of these tumors.
(1) Renal carcinoma may be associated with paraneoplastic and/or serologic syndrome(s).

the elucidation of the molecular basis of the paraneoplastic syndromes and the serologic syndrom of renal carcinoma.
understanding the molecular mechanisms that control normal and abnormal cellular proliferation, and how these mechanisms can be exploited in the development of novel therapies.
